N rows = N runs

one BulkBatchConfig"] Bulk --> Run2["Run 2"] Bulk --> RunN["Run N"] Run1 --> Scn1["Scenario 1
seed = base + 0"] Run1 --> Scn2["Scenario 2
seed = base + 1"] Run1 --> ScnM["Scenario M
seed = base + M-1"] Scn1 --> Out1["scenario_1.csv
(per-day StepRecord)"] Scn2 --> Out2["scenario_2.csv"] ScnM --> OutM["scenario_M.csv"] Run1 --> Agg1["aggregate.csv
(cross-scenario stats)"] Run1 --> Cfg1["config.csv
(env + species dump)"] Run2 --> Agg2["aggregate.csv"] Run2 --> Cfg2["config.csv"] RunN --> AggN["aggregate.csv"] RunN --> CfgN["config.csv"] Bulk --> BulkSum["bulk_summary.csv
(ZIP root, generated by BulkSimulationController.GenerateBulkSummary)"]
scenario-flow:
flowchart TD Start([Start scenario]) --> Init["Initialize species
from RunSpeciesList
(fallback: InitializeDefaultSpecies)"] Init --> TempInit["Seed TemperatureCalculator
seed = BaseSeed + scenarioIndex"] TempInit --> DayLoop{"dayIndex < TotalDays?"} DayLoop -- yes --> Temp["temp = TempCalc.GetTemperature(dayIndex)"] Temp --> RunBio{"dayIndex == 0 OR
(dayIndex+1) % BiologyStep == 0?"} RunBio -- yes --> Biology["EcosystemSimulator.ProcessBiologyStep(temp)
(10 sub-steps; see biology-overview)"] RunBio -- no --> Record Biology --> Record["RecordStep:
temp, populations (long), condition,
births, deaths, accumulators,
reproScale, hunting stats"] Record --> Crashed{"biology ran AND
Ecosystem.HasCrashed()?"} Crashed -- yes --> MarkCrash["HasCrashed = true
set CrashDay, CrashTier
break loop"] Crashed -- no --> NextDay["dayIndex += 1"] NextDay --> DayLoop DayLoop -- no --> Emit MarkCrash --> Emit Emit["ToCsvInternal:
#config: header
#species: table
daily StepRecord rows
#summary: stats
#extinction: per-variant timing"] Emit --> Return["ToScenarioResult →
emits per-day CSV + stats to controller"] Return --> End([End scenario])
temperature-model:
flowchart LR Base["BaseTemperature
(default 20°C)"] --> Sum(("+")) Seasonal["Seasonal
sin(2π · day / 365)
× SeasonalAmplitude"] --> Sum Trend["Climate trend
ClimateTrendPerYear × (day / 365)
linear"] --> Sum Inter["Interannual variation
per-year zero-mean offset
(cold + warm) / 2 − biasMean
cached in _yearVariations
(skipped if UseInterannualVariation=false)"] --> Sum Daily["Daily variation
R = BaseRandomness + RandomnessGrowthRate × year
newRandom = uniform(-R, +R)"] --> AC{"UseAutocorrelation?"} AC -- yes --> Smooth["v = 0.7 × _previousDayVariation + 0.3 × newRandom"] AC -- no --> Raw["v = newRandom"] Smooth --> Sum Raw --> Sum Sum --> Clamp["clamp to
[MinTemp, MaxTemp]"] Clamp --> Out["T(day) °C"]
biology-overview:
flowchart TD Start([ProcessBiologyStep temp]) --> S1["1. Thermal Performance
SimSpecies.CalculatePerformance
Arrhenius + CTmin/CTmax cosine fade
RawThermalPerf; ThermalPerf = Raw × Pmax"] S1 --> S2["2. Feeding / Predation
Tier 1: FedRate = min(1, HE × food_density), linear (v10)
Tier 2: Holling II + per-predator FedRate (v11)
fedRate_i = min(1, huntingSuccess_i × scarcityFactor)
_predationAccumulators on prey"] S2 --> S3["3. Raw Final Performance
RawFinalPerf = Raw × FedRate
(Condition drain target — varies with food density for Tier 1 in v10)"] S3 --> S4["4. Update Condition
asymmetric drift toward target
rates scaled by Pmax (pmaxSafe)"] S4 --> S5["5. Final Performance
FinalPerf = ThermalPerf × FedRate
(computed for logging; not read downstream)"] S5 --> S6["6. Thermal Death
instant wipeout when RawThermalPerf == 0"] S6 --> S7["7. Condition Death
graduated severity below DeathThreshold
survivor fitness boost
_conditionDeathAccumulators"] S7 --> S8["8. Reproduction (v10: no soft cap on births)
reproScale(Condition) × Pmax
Tier 1 NO_PREDATOR_PENALTY only
_birthAccumulators
newborns inherit parent group Condition"] S8 --> S9["9. Natural Death
flat NaturalDeathRate ± variance
_naturalDeathAccumulators"] S9 --> S10["10. Population Rounding
round away-from-zero"] S10 --> End([End step])
biology-performance-phase:
flowchart TD Temp["Temperature °C"] --> Offset["T_eff = T + sp.TemperatureDebuff"] Offset --> Fade["Cosine fade over
LETHAL_TRANSITION_WIDTH = 2°C
near CTminC / CTmaxC"] Fade --> Arr["Arrhenius in Kelvin:
numerator = exp(B/OT − B/T) · (1 + exp(L/OT − L/LB) + exp(U/UB − U/OT))
denominator = 1 + exp(L/T − L/LB) + exp(U/UB − U/T)
perf = clamp(num/den, 0, 1)"] Arr --> Raw["RawThermalPerformance
= perf × fade"] Raw --> TP["ThermalPerformance
= Raw × Pmax"] Pop1["tier1Pop = sum of Tier 1 populations"] --> FoodDensity["food_density = max(0, 1 − tier1Pop / cap)
cap always on (v11.1); cap floored at 1"] FoodDensity --> FedRateT1["FedRate (Tier 1, v10) = min(1, HE × food_density)
linear extraction (NOT Holling II)"] TP --> PredDemand["Predator rawDemand
= Pop × EatingAmount × ThermalPerf × BiologyStep"] PredDemand --> Holling["Holling II success
holling = ratio / (ratio + halfSat)
halfSat = NORMAL_PREY_RATIO · (1 − base) / base
+ variance in [-HuntingVariance, +HuntingVariance]
clamp to [0, 1]"] Holling --> Actual["actualDemand = rawDemand × huntingSuccess"] Actual --> Eaten["totalEaten = min(availablePrey, Σ actualDemand)"] Eaten --> ScarcityT2["scarcityFactor (v11)
= totalEaten / totalActualDemand
(1.0 when prey abundant)"] ScarcityT2 --> FedRateT2["FedRate_i (Tier 2, v11)
= min(1, huntingSuccess_i × scarcityFactor)
(per-predator; LastFedRateT2 = pop-weighted avg)"] Raw --> RFP["RawFinalPerformance
= Raw × FedRate
(Condition drain target)"] FedRateT1 --> RFP FedRateT2 --> RFP RFP --> CondStep{"Condition vs target
(pmaxSafe = max(Pmax, 1e-4))"} CondStep -- "Cond > target" --> Drain["severity = (1 - target)²
effectiveDrain = ConditionDrainRate · (1 + severity) / pmaxSafe
Condition -= (Condition - target) × effectiveDrain"] CondStep -- "Cond < target" --> Recov["boost = target²
effectiveRecovery = ConditionRecoveryRate · (1 + boost) × pmaxSafe
Condition += (target - Condition) × effectiveRecovery"] Drain --> Clamp["Condition = clamp(Condition, 0, 1)"] Recov --> Clamp Clamp --> FP["FinalPerformance
= ThermalPerf × FedRate
(logging only)"]
biology-death-phase:
flowchart TD Start([Start death phase]) --> Pop{"sp.Population < MIN_ALIVE_POP?"} Pop -- yes --> Skip[already extinct; skip] Pop -- no --> S6{"Step 6: Thermal Death
sp.RawThermalPerformance == 0?"} S6 -- yes --> Wipe["Pop → 0
Condition → 0
LastTempDeaths += deaths"] S6 -- no --> S7{"Step 7: Condition Death
sp.Condition < sp.DeathThreshold?"} S7 -- no --> NoDeaths[no condition deaths] S7 -- yes --> Sev["severity = (DeathThreshold - Condition) / DeathThreshold
rawDeaths = Pop × severity × DeathRate × BiologyStep"] Sev --> Accum["_conditionDeathAccumulators[sp.FullName] += rawDeaths
whole = floor(accum)
cap at int(Pop)"] Accum --> WholeCheck{"whole > 0?"} WholeCheck -- no --> Fractional[keep fractional residual
for next day] WholeCheck -- yes --> Kill["Pop = max(0, Pop - wholeDeaths)"] Kill --> Boost["Survivor fitness boost:
Condition = min(1, oldCond × oldPop / newPop)"] Boost --> Next[next species] Wipe --> Next Skip --> Next NoDeaths --> Next Fractional --> Next
biology-life-phase:
flowchart TD Start([Start life phase]) --> Guard{"sp.Population < MIN_POPULATION_FOR_REPRODUCTION (2)?"} Guard -- yes --> SkipRepro[skip reproduction] Guard -- no --> ThreshCheck{"ReproThreshold check"} ThreshCheck -- "thresh ≥ 1.0 (edge)" --> EdgeA["reproScale = STRUGGLING_REPRO_RATE × Condition"] ThreshCheck -- "thresh ≤ 0 (edge)" --> EdgeB["reproScale = Condition"] ThreshCheck -- "Cond ≥ thresh" --> Healthy["t = (Cond − thresh) / (1 − thresh)
reproScale = STRUGGLING_REPRO_RATE + (1 − STRUGGLING_REPRO_RATE) × t
ramps 0.10 → 1.0"] ThreshCheck -- "Cond < thresh" --> Struggling["reproScale = STRUGGLING_REPRO_RATE × (Cond / thresh)
ramps 0 → 0.10"] Healthy --> Clamp["reproScale = clamp(reproScale, 0, 1)"] Struggling --> Clamp EdgeA --> Clamp EdgeB --> Clamp Clamp --> Births["births = Pop × reproScale × ReproductionMultiplier × Pmax × BiologyStep"] Births --> T1NoPred{"Tier == 1 AND
GetTierPopulation(2) < MIN_ALIVE_POP?"} T1NoPred -- yes --> NPP["births *= NO_PREDATOR_PENALTY (0.85)"] T1NoPred -- no --> BAcc NPP --> BAcc["_birthAccumulators[sp.FullName] += births
accumulated = _birthAccumulators[sp.FullName]"] BAcc --> Whole["wholeBirths = floor(accumulated)
residual = accumulated − wholeBirths
_birthAccumulators[sp.FullName] = residual"] Whole --> AddPop["sp.Population += wholeBirths
(newborns inherit group Condition; v10 — no explicit dilution step,
population-weighted average is unchanged when newborns match group)"] AddPop --> S9 SkipRepro --> S9 S9["Step 9: Natural Death
rate = NaturalDeathRate ± uniform(-NaturalDeathVariance, +NaturalDeathVariance)
rate = max(0, rate)
rawDeaths = Pop × rate × BiologyStep"] --> NAcc["_naturalDeathAccumulators[sp.FullName] += rawDeaths
apply floor(accum) whole deaths"] NAcc --> Next[next species]
pmax-flow:
flowchart LR Pmax["sp.Pmax
(peak metabolic capacity)"] --> S1["Step 1: ThermalPerformance = RawThermalPerf × Pmax"] Pmax --> S4a["Step 4: effectiveDrain
= DrainRate × (1 + severity²) / pmaxSafe"] Pmax --> S4b["Step 4: effectiveRecovery
= RecoveryRate × (1 + target²) × pmaxSafe"] Pmax --> S8["Step 8: births
= Pop × reproScale × ReproMult × Pmax × BiologyStep"] S1 --> S2["Step 2: rawDemand
= Pop × EatingAmount × ThermalPerformance × BiologyStep
(predator hunting demand)"] S4a --> Cond["Condition [0, 1]
(target unchanged; ceiling still 1.0)"] S4b --> Cond S8 --> Births[Birth accumulator → Pop next day] style Pmax fill:#ffe4b5,stroke:#333
csv-output-shape:
flowchart TD Run[One run] --> PerScn["Per-scenario CSV
scenario_{N}.csv"] Run --> Agg["aggregate.csv
(one per run)"] Run --> Cfg["config.csv
(one per run)"] PerScn --> PH["#config: header
(20 lines: model_version (v12),
days, scenarios, seed, biology step,
11 temp params, carrying cap, drain/recovery)"] PerScn --> PS["#species: table
(1 header row + 1 row per species
with 26 columns inc. both K and C
for temperature fields)"] PerScn --> PD["Daily data rows
(StepRecord.CsvHeader/ToCsvLine)
Day..ReproScaleT2 per day +
17 per-species columns × N species (v12)"] PerScn --> PSum["#summary: statistics block
Mean/Max/Min/StdDev across days
for each PopColumn"] PerScn --> PExt["#extinction: per-variant timing
day reached zero, or -1 if survived"] Agg --> AH["=== TINYSEA AGGREGATE RESULTS ===
# metadata (generated timestamp, config summary)"] Agg --> AS["=== SUMMARY ===
Scenarios Run, Survived, Crashed,
Crash Rate, Avg Crash Day"] Agg --> APop["=== POPULATION STATS (Survived Only) ===
Avg/Min/Max Final T1 and T2"] Agg --> APer["=== PER-SPECIES POPULATION STATS ===
Avg, SurvivedAvg, Min, Max,
Extinct, Survived, ExtinctionRate"] Agg --> ACond["=== CONDITION STATS ===
Avg and Final Condition per tier"] Agg --> APerFY["=== PER-SPECIES FINAL YEAR METRICS === (v12)
MeanCondition/BirthRate/PopCv/MeanPop
w/ Mean, StdDev, SurvivedMean per species"] Agg --> APerFR["=== PER-SPECIES FULL-RUN METRICS === (v12)
Same metrics over entire scenario"] Agg --> APerST["=== PER-SPECIES STABILITY METRICS === (v12)
Min/Max/FinalPop, ExtinctionRate,
MeanExtinctionDay, CrashRate, MeanCrashDay"] Agg --> AInd["=== INDIVIDUAL SCENARIOS ===
one row per scenario"] Agg --> AGrand["=== SUMMARY STATISTICS
(Grand Mean Across All Runs) ===
GrandMean of Mean/Max/Min/StdDev"] Agg --> AExt["=== EXTINCTION TIMING ===
Min/Max/Avg days; extinct vs survived counts"] Cfg --> CH["=== section headers ===
# metadata lines
Parameter,Value rows for environment"] Cfg --> CSpc["=== SPECIES ===
(same 26-column table as #species: in scenario CSV)"] Bulk[Bulk upload] --> BulkSum["bulk_summary.csv
(ZIP root, one per bulk)"] BulkSum --> BS1["=== TINYSEA BULK SUMMARY ===
# Model Version (v12), # Total Runs, # Generated"] BulkSum --> BS2["=== PER-RUN RESULTS ===
Run, Scenarios, Survived, Crashed,
CrashRate, BaseTemp, ClimateTrend,
per-species average populations"] BulkSum --> BS3["=== PER-SPECIES AGGREGATE (Across All Runs) ===
Species, GrandMean, SurvivedMean,
RunsExtinct, RunsSurvived, ExtinctionRate"] BulkSum --> BS4["=== PER-RUN PER-SPECIES FINAL YEAR === (v12)
(run × species) detail rows"] BulkSum --> BS5["=== CROSS-RUN PER-SPECIES FINAL YEAR === (v12)
GrandMeanCondition/BirthRate/PopCv/MeanPop
across runs (w/ StdDev)"] BulkSum --> BS6["=== CROSS-RUN STABILITY === (v12)
Pooled extinction/crash rates and mean days"]
accumulator-pattern:
flowchart LR Raw["rawEvents
= Pop × rate × BiologyStep
(float, fractional)"] --> Add["accumulator[sp.FullName] += rawEvents"] Add --> Floor["whole = (int)Math.Floor(accumulator[sp.FullName])"] Floor --> Apply["apply 'whole' integer events
